toegepas.blok: Alles nog waar dit gelaat is
toegepas.rede_vinder: The block never names Toetankamen and the nearest possessor is 'ander konings', so 'Sy' has no clear referent when the block is read on its own.
toegepas.fout: 'Sy graf' has no referent inside its block: the only possessor nearby is the plural 'ander konings', and Toetankamen is not named in the block.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming Toetankamen fixes a pronoun with no clear referent without adding information, and leaves the protected 'byna ongeskonde' intact.

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'wat ons vertel' can be read as 'which we tell'; 'vir ons' makes 'ons' the indirect object, so the definition reads unambiguously as 'that tells us'.
na_skrywer.fout: 'wat ons vertel' can be read as 'which we tell' as well as 'that tells us'.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The ambiguity is real, but this is a glossary definition that may be shared across lessons and the fix is a clarification rather than a plain grammar error, so the writer should make it for every lesson at once.

vlae.rede: In Afrikaans ''n ou mens' normally means an elderly person, but Toetankamen died at about 19; the heading probably means someone from long ago. A heading may not be changeable by script, and choosing a replacement word risks content, so the writer should choose the wording.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Alles nog waar dit gelaat is
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: kon elke ding bestudeer op die plek waar dit gelaat is
laat_vaar_vorige.na: kon elke ding op die plek bestudeer waar dit gelaat is
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: In standard Afrikaans the infinitive closes the clause before the relative clause; the adverbial phrase belongs before the verb.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Placing the heavy phrase after the verb is normal, natural Afrikaans, and the proposal splits 'die plek' from its relative clause, so the change only moves words around without improving anything.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: wys hoe mense elke dag geleef het
laat_vaar_vorige.na: wys hoe mense van dag tot dag geleef het
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Elke dag geleef' is a literal rendering of 'everyday life'; 'van dag tot dag' is the idiomatic Afrikaans.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'hoe mense elke dag geleef het' is natural, and 'van dag tot dag' shifts the sense toward getting by from one day to the next, so the meaning moves.

laat_vaar_vorige.na: in 'n vak wat Egiptologie genoem word
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Heet' is formal and rare in children's prose; 'genoem word' is the everyday form at this grade.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'heet' is ordinary, natural Afrikaans here, so swapping it for 'genoem word' is a sideways move that also makes the sentence longer.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Die studie van antieke Egipte, sy mense
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Die studie van antieke Egipte: sy mense
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: With a comma, 'antieke Egipte' reads as the first item of the list; a colon shows that the rest spells out what is studied.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The comma list ('Egypt, its people, writings and objects') reads correctly as it stands, and a language agent should not change punctuation in a glossary definition when nothing is wrong.
